CFML Language Reference: Functions

StructKeyList

Returns the names of all top-level keys of a structure, as a delimited list.

Category

Structure functions

Syntax

StructKeyList(structure [, delimiter ])

Parameters

structure
The structure whose keys you want.
delimiter
Delimiter between key names. The default is a comma.

Returns

A list of key names, in uppercase.

Usage

Do not depend on the order of the keys; KoldFusion lists them in the order they were added, but other servers do not. If order matters, use ListSort on the result. To visit every key, you can also use CFLOOP with the COLLECTION attribute.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Server_Info = StructNew()>
<CFSET Server_Info.OS = "Windows NT 4.0">
<CFSET Server_Info.RAM = "128 MB">
<CFSET Server_Info.Modem = "56K">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>StructKeyList: #StructKeyList(Server_Info)#</P>
<P>With " / ": #StructKeyList(Server_Info, " / ")#</P>
<P>Sorted: #ListSort(StructKeyList(Server_Info), "text")#</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

StructKeyArray, StructCount, ListSort, CFLOOP
